backend/main.mo: Empty actor canister; no backend logic implemented.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing components, files, and metadata for deploying the latest landing page.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-style list providing short descriptions of all major frontend files and their roles.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide describing ICP hosting, deployment steps, and public URL usage.
frontend/deployment/latest-public-urls.m: Public URL handoff file for production integrations with placeholder sections.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH theme tokens and dark mode palette.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with metadata, canonical URL, Open Graph tags, and asset links.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: Domain allowlist enabling ICP custom domain support for smartsalonapp.com.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component wrapping the LandingPage with dark mode.
frontend/src/components/legal/ContactVie: Legal contact section showing email and phone details with styled cards.
frontend/src/components/legal/LegalModal: Reusable modal with scrollable content for displaying legal documents.
frontend/src/components/legal/PrivacyPol: Privacy policy component rendering detailed policy text using COMPANY_INFO and CONTACT_INFO.
Terms and Conditions component outlining platform rules, bookings, and payments.
frontend/src/content/legal.ts: Exports shared contact info and company metadata for legal components.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook creating and managing authenticated or anonymous actors with query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, handling identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind CSS styles and custom theme variables for a dark luxury aesthetic with gold accents.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and the Internet Identity provider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Implements the Smart Salon landing page with hero content, header branding, feature highlights, and legal modals.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, shadows, breakpoints, and plugins for the project's design system.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, requirements, design rules, and known issues related to the Smart Salon landing page overhaul.
